fees.description:
Charged when a direct debit payment has dishonoured or reversed. This charge is not subject to GST.
Additional fees may apply. For more information, please visit the retailers website at energy.arcline.com.au/fees
May be charged when you move into a property or change retailer. Actual fee may vary.
May be charged when you move out and require a final meter read. Actual fee may vary.

We accept Visa and Mastercard payments via energy.arcline.com.au/payment. Debit card transactions are subject to a 0.46% fee, and credit card payments incur a 0.81% fee. Card processing fees are waived for Direct Debit payments.
May apply for over the counter payments made at an Australia Post outlet.
May be charged where you request a change, removal or installation of an electricity meter. It is to arrange metering-related goods or services for you with a meter provider or distributor.

electricityContract.terms: Arcline by RACV is provided by EL Retail Energy Pty Ltd. For more information in relation to Arcline by RACV and this offer, see our full terms and conditions at https://energy.arcline.com.au/terms/

discounts.description: Receive a $25 (incl GST) one-off sign up credit on your first bill. T&Cs apply: Arcline by RACV: Terms and Conditions | Arcline by RACV

electricityContract.variation: Due to changes in the market and economic conditions, we may update your tariff and/or fees. We will provide at least 5 business days' notice before the change takes place.

incentives.eligibility: Receive a $50 account credit if you mention an existing Arcline by RACV customer when you join. The friend also gets $50 credit. T&Cs apply - Visit Arcline by RACV Terms and Conditions page for more information: https://energy.arcline.com.au/terms/

eligibility.information: Available to Victorian residential customers with valid RACV memberships.
